text: ③これで　えらんだ　ポケモンが　たたかいに　とびだして　いきます！

structure.jp: えらんだ　ポケモンが
とびだして　いきます！

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.span: とびだして　いきます
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form verb shows the action moving away from where you are. とびだして　いきます = 'goes leaping out'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: えらんだ　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing tells you which one is meant. えらんだ　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon you chose'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says that it is what gets the job done. これで = 'with this'.
